findings.rule: Async vault receipt replace/revoke handlers and standalone bridge sendDraft should handle rejections without unhandled promises or premature draft loss
findings.message: VaultReceiptCard.handleConfirmReplace (lines 84-90) resets replacementSecret and replacing before awaiting onReplace and invokes void handleConfirmReplace() / void onRevoke(receipt.receiptId) (lines 102, 110) without try/catch. Neither useAgentChatConversation.ts (handleReplaceVaultReceipt / handleRevokeVaultReceipt, lines 244-254) nor ChatPrimitivesBridge.tsx (onReplaceReceipt / onRevokeReceipt, lines 168-178) catches API rejections, resulting in unhandled promise rejections and no chatVaultError/statusError UI feedback when replace or revoke fails. Separately, standalone ChatPrimitivesBridge.tsx:113 clears setDraft("") before awaiting submitChatBridgeTurn.
findings.remediation: Wrap handleReplaceVaultReceipt / handleRevokeVaultReceipt (and ChatPrimitivesBridge counterparts) in try/catch to surface failures via setChatVaultError / setStatusError, and add try/catch in VaultReceiptCard around onReplace/onRevoke.

findings.rule: Vite BFF CAS upload body ceiling check should match both /api/v1/cas/upload and normalized /api/cas/upload alias
findings.message: matchBffRoute (vite-bff-routes.ts:190-192) normalizes /api/v1/* to /api/* so CHAT_VAULT_ROUTES matches POST /api/cas/upload as well as POST /api/v1/cas/upload, whereas dispatchMiddlewareRequest (vite-bff-plugin.ts:175) checks parsedUrl.pathname === "/api/v1/cas/upload" literally. Active SDK callers (src/api/chat-vault.ts:86) and tests target /api/v1/cas/upload, so normal runtime behavior is unaffected, though direct calls to /api/cas/upload still hit the 1 MiB MAX_BODY_BYTES cap.
findings.code_snippet:
const isCasUpload = method === "POST" && parsedUrl.pathname === "/api/v1/cas/upload";
  const rawBuf = await readRawBody(req, isCasUpload ? MAX_CAS_UPLOAD_BODY_BYTES : MAX_BODY_BYTES);
findings.remediation: Normalize pathname check in vite-bff-plugin.ts to match both "/api/v1/cas/upload" and "/api/cas/upload".
